scenes.exactPrompt:
Create one connected landscape teaching illustration in 3:2 format. Full-bleed scenic background, no lettering, numbers, labels, legends, painted highlights, arrows, inset boxes, multiple panels, border, or cutaway diagrams. Clear silhouettes and a simple background allow the app to highlight the actual parts with separate vector paths. Style: Children's educational field-guide illustration in hand-painted opaque gouache, like a premium illustrated primary science app. Saturated natural local colours, subtly visible dry brush within shapes, dark coloured contour accents, simplified factual geometry, crisp silhouettes and modest hand-rendered shading. Predominantly matte and brush-painted. Background quieter and paler than teaching targets. Crisp focal details stay readable when the whole scene is viewed on a phone.

One complete cobalt-blue and golden-yellow city bicycle, same painted field-guide appearance as a blue bicycle vocabulary cutout, in a quiet paved school courtyard with a low hedge and muted sage plants. Make the bicycle fill most of the wide picture with 8% clear breathing room. It faces right and is seen almost side-on, with the camera just enough toward its front to show a complete gently curved handlebar with two dark grips. Put a distinct brass bell with visible thumb lever high on the handlebar, separated from the frame and set against light negative space. Show two round spoked wheels with visibly thick dark rubber tyres, open interiors, clearly drawn rims and hubs; the front wheel on the right is completely unobstructed except where its fork meets the hub. One amber near-side pedal is large, horizontally exposed just below the crank and well between the wheels. No people, basket, rack cargo, signs or other bicycles. Render mechanically plausible fork, frame, seat and pedals.
